clips.title: The story
paras: Three Corners is a vital crossroads nestled just inside the western border of the Redridge Mountains. Branching toward the three neighboring towns of Goldshire, Lakeshire, and Darkshire, it marks the boundary between the heart of the kingdom and Redridge's perilous wilderness. A Stormwind Guard watchtower stands over the intersection, holding the line against encroaching gnoll packs.

Situated at the western edge of the Redridge Mountains, Three Corners connects three key Alliance settlements: Goldshire in Elwynn Forest to the west, Lakeshire to the northeast, and Darkshire in Duskwood to the south. Because of this strategic junction, Stormwind erected Tower Watch at the center of the crossroads. Manning the post, local guards and scouts attempt to keep the thoroughfares clear of Redridge's aggressive gnolls, who constantly threaten travelers and supply wagons passing between the regions.
